name: Heat equation
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="2">
    <description>
        Here the heat equation applies to chemical <i>a</i> but only in those places 
        where chemical <i>b</i> is zero. This has the effect of locking certain areas to
        their starting values and shows how the heat equation can interpolate betweeen values in a 
        spatial field. This is known as <i>solving</i> the heat equation with fixed 
        boundary conditions, or as 
        <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kriging">kriging</a>.
    </description>

    <rule type="formula" name="Heat equation" wrap="0">
        
      <param name="timestep"> 0.2 </param>

      <formula number_of_chemicals="2">
        delta_a = laplacian_a * step(-0.01f,-b);
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="0.7" />
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.2" z="0.4" />
          <point3D x="0.4" y="0.8" z="0.6" />
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="0.5" />
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.55" y="0.2" z="0.4" />
          <point3D x="0.8" y="0.3" z="0.6" />
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="1" />
        <circle radius="0.1">
          <point3D x="0.7" y="0.8" z="0.6" />
        </circle>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite />
        <other_chemical chemical="b" />
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    
    <render_settings>
      <active_chemical value="a" />
      <color_displacement_mapped_surface value="false" />
      <vertical_scale_2D value="50" />
    </render_settings>
    
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 127 0 127 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
